questions.question: What is the PRIMARY purpose of a thesis statement in an argumentative essay?
choices: To summarise the entire essay in detail
To present a clear, arguable position on the topic
To list all the arguments you will use
To introduce yourself to the reader

questions.question: In an argumentative essay, each body paragraph should present only one main idea or argument.
Réécris la conclusion faible suivante en l'améliorant : 'In conclusion, social media is bad. I think people should use it less.'
Which discourse marker is best used to introduce a CONTRASTING argument?
Using informal contractions like 'don't', 'can't', 'it's' is perfectly acceptable in a formal argumentative essay.

Identifie la structure PEEL dans ce paragraphe et nomme chaque partie : 'Firstly, excessive screen time negatively affects children's sleep. Studies show that blue light from screens suppresses melatonin production. For example, a 2022 WHO report found that children using devices before bed slept 45 minutes less on average. Therefore, limiting screen time is essential for healthy development.'
Which sentence is the most effective thesis statement for an essay about the benefits of renewable energy?
choices: This essay will discuss renewable energy.
Although transitioning to renewable energy requires significant investment, its long-term environmental and economic benefits make it an essential solution to climate change.
Many people think renewable energy is important.

questions.question: The introduction of an argumentative essay should reveal all your arguments in full detail.

exercisenotion.description: Un essay argumentatif en anglais suit généralement la structure : Introduction (hook + context + thesis statement) → Body paragraphs (argument + evidence + example, un paragraphe par idée) → Conclusion (restatement of thesis + summary + final thought). Chaque paragraphe doit être cohérent et connecté par des discourse markers.

La thesis statement est la phrase principale de l'introduction qui présente clairement la position de l'auteur. Elle doit être précise, arguable et annoncer le plan. Ex : 'Although social media has some benefits, its negative impact on mental health and social skills outweighs its advantages.' Elle guide tout le développement de l'essay.

Chaque body paragraph suit la structure PEEL : Point (idée principale), Evidence (preuve/donnée), Example (exemple concret), Link (lien avec la thesis). Les arguments doivent être développés, pas seulement listés. Utiliser des discourse markers : Furthermore, However, In addition, On the other hand, As a result, In conclusion.
